comparison.objective: Orient and lay plasterboards so their ends land on joists, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-board reorientation and supported placement versus small-tool engagement, fine rotation, bounded tightening, and impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Each board square across joists with supported ends versus two safe repeatable stops with no drift or hard-stop strike.
comparison.reason: Large planar placement tests a different ability from adjusting and retaining a damping setting. No specs give board tolerances beyond the described scoring.
